Subject: a recognizably triangular tri-tip beef roast, with its tapered triangular shape clearly readable and a dark coffee-ancho spice crust. Several slices beside the remaining roast show warm rosy interiors. Beside the beef, place one small bowl of creamy pale orange chipotle-lime yogurt sauce and one lime wedge.
Style/medium: photorealistic, natural editorial food photography with realistic meat grain, gently moist cut surfaces, textured spice crust, creamy sauce, and rustic serving-board texture.
Composition/framing: landscape, gently elevated three-quarter food-photography view. Arrange the food mainly in the right two-thirds of the image, leaving the left third dark, quiet negative space for a title to be overlaid later. Keep the roast, every slice, sauce bowl, and lime wedge fully inside the frame with comfortable margins. Preserve the recognizable triangular roast silhouette. The left negative space should blend naturally into the same scene.
Lighting/mood: warm side lighting, appetizing natural highlights, deep charcoal shadows, rustic editorial styling consistent with a charcoal/ember gas-grilling app.
Constraints: one continuous photograph-like image only; original composition; no recreation of any publisher's photograph.
Avoid: text, lettering, logos, watermarks, UI, borders, collage, branded props, extra dishes, decorative clutter, cropped food, plastic-looking food, exaggerated saturation.
